search.snippet: The white platelegs are a piece of White Knight armour that requires 10 Defence and the completion of the Wanted! quest to wield. They have the same bonuses as the black platelegs, with an added +1 Prayer bonus, and have the same stats as a white plateskirt but weigh more.
search.title: White platelegs - OSRS Wiki

search.snippet: Item is now created at the Armour Bench, as the Smithing Anvil has been removed from the game. White platelegs is a power level 5 melee armour that can be created at an armour bench.
search.title: White Platelegs - RuneScape: Dragonwilds Wiki

search.snippet: They can only be bought from Lanthus. The white decorative legs and their skirt counterpart offer similar stats to the mithril platelegs but weigh more. These require level 20 Defence to wear. This item can be stored in the armour case of a costume room, as part of the Castle Wars armour (2) set.
search.title: Decorative armour (white platelegs) - OSRS Wiki

search.snippet: To wear white platelegs, the player must have completed the Wanted! quest and have at least 10 Defence. One can either buy them from Sir Vyvin (with the Novice rank) or trade with another player.
